interpretations: For each trader type, including a separate group for traders with no type, count distinct traders whose `tradereg` exactly matches the `trdref` of at least one transaction record. Return only types whose count exceeds the unweighted average of those per-type counts, with the type, count, count divided by the sum of all per-type counts, and count minus the average. Do not round; return no rows if the average is missing.
queries:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS trader_count
  FROM trader AS t
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS avg_count,
         SUM(trader_count) AS total_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT tc.trader_type,
       tc.trader_count,
       1.0 * tc.trader_count / totals.total_count AS proportion,
       tc.trader_count - totals.avg_count AS difference_from_average
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN totals
WHERE tc.trader_count > totals.avg_count;
